# Lima Samudra

> Lima Samudra is a seafood and frozen food supplier and distributor based in Surabaya, East Java, Indonesia. It supplies hotels, restaurants and catering businesses (HoReCa) across Indonesia with dried, frozen and canned seafood, Chinese delicacies and frozen beef. Prices are given on request.

Also known as: Lima Samudra Surabaya. Local trade names: haisom or haesom (sea cucumber), hisit (shark fin), hipio (fish maw). Website languages: Indonesian, English, Chinese.

## Contact

- Website: https://limasamudra.com/
- WhatsApp / phone: +62 851-9006-1790
- WeChat ID: christofsusanto
- Email: limasamudra.trade@gmail.com
- Location: Surabaya, East Java, Indonesia (street address not published on the website)
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 08:00-17:00 WIB (Western Indonesia Time)
